children.text: This section displays the artistic process that goes into editing videos for fandom. Slicing up clips and creating these story lines is labor intenstive.
Another example of how creating these videos was a labor intensive process, but stimulated a digital community within the process.

Dives deep into a major turning point for editing with the example of: The Phantom Edit. This edit demonstrates fans going beyond consuming the movie but reinterpreting and alterign the existing text. Fan editing becomes something that can attract public attention.

Fan editors take a step futher by restoring or changing films, which is a clear example of the emotional investment fans put into these pieces of medias. Spending enormous amounts of time laboring simply because the original work matters so much to them.

This portion of the video discusses copyright laws and discusses the question of "who has the right to alter media?" Contrasting fans who are creatively engaging with X media versues the entertainment industry OWNING the original material.
Fan editing becomes way easier to create and distribute online.

Amalie's Bastard was an incredibly popular instagram multi-fandom editor, and how it was able to pull in multiple audiences into editing. It also displays the general shift to algorthims favoring edit videos then versues edit videos being popular now is popular for different reasons.

Editors start teaching others how to make similar videos by showing their transitions or effects techniques to what software they use. Here fan editing shifts from an individual users hobby to more of this shared creative culture.

A shift towards short-form content and algorithmic visiblity is happening within the editing community. The video discusses the iconic Wednesday fan edit which received an enormous amount of engagement!

Entertainment companies now incorpate edits into their ads for marketing purposes. Editors who developed their skills and audiences through fandom can now be hired by companies and publications. This turns what began as participatory fandom into something that can generate economic value.
